notes.itemTitle: Book the first CDC coaching session
notes.title: Your coach has written
notes.text: Liesbeth Van Loock is your career coach, and P0 slots are open from 2 November to 1 December on CareerGlobe. She wants your CareerLeader and Career Anchors scores put on the CareerPlan Workbook and emailed to her at least 48 hours before the session. - Worth booking before you fly on the 4th.
